subject: New version of AHMbook (0.1.4) now on CRAN

messages.author: 72444bb824190d51
messages.subject: New version of AHMbook (0.1.4) now on CRAN
parts:
Version 0.1.4 of AHMbook package has bug fixes and improvements, but no new functions or data sets. The changes are:
  • In sim.spatialDS, the old "hazard" detection function has been removed (see Errata for p.540). It's replaced with a new "logit" detection function which is the same as the detection model fitted by pcount.spHDS in version 0.12-2 of unmarked.
  • More information and additional examples added to several help pages.
  • Fixed: argument discard0 in simHDS now works as documented.
  • Fixed: bugs in issj.sim which produced errors with argument values other than those in the book; tidied up ambiguity in help page with nsites and npoints; added example.
